class.name: OcgStandardClocalesentry
class.brief_description: This class intended to temporary switch C locale and logically equivalent to setlocale(LC_ALL, "C"). It is intended to format text regardless of user locale settings (for import/export functionality). Thus following calls to Sprintf, atoi and other functions will use "C" locale. Destructor of this class will return original locale.
class.description: ! This class intended to temporary switch C locale and logically equivalent to setlocale(LC_ALL, ! "C"). It is intended to format text regardless of user locale settings (for import/export ! functionality). Thus following calls to Sprintf, atoi and other functions will use "C" locale. ! Destructor of this class will return original locale. ! ! Notice that this functionality is platform dependent and intended only to workaround alien code ! that doesn't setup locale correctly. ! ! Internally you should prefer more portable C++ locale interfaces ! or OCCT wrappers to some C functions like Sprintf, Atof, Strtod.
